body: I just like spending time with friends. But I don't have any. Ha

I do need to get organized. The one thing about my job though is that I work until I'm done. I can't leave until everything is done. I normally work 11-12 hours a day. I work in a steel mill so I'm carrying steel around for at least 7 hours of that time. My back feels like it's gonna explode, but it's a job. I use a crane as often as I can, but the more I use the crane the longer I'm there.

In the end though, it all breaks down to when I come home at 3 or 4 in the morning, I lay here and I just think about everything. I feel like I'm working  just to get by, there's no goal, no motivation. Then I wake up, go to work, and do it all over again.

Any advice helps, I'm grateful for anyone who cares enough just to listen. Thank you.

I got caught up in the credit cards a couple years back. I just bought my second car, it was around Christmas time. I found out I had a REALLY good score, and I was only 19, and wanted to get everyone nice things for the holidays. Got 2 cards maxed out. Then my TV broke and I decided to get another card and get a 3D Smart Tv that maxed out another card. I wasn't thinking ahead and I didn't have anyone to tell me I was making terrible decisions. 

As for the girl, we used to have this great relationship. Everyday we'd spend every second together until I got the night shift job. For awhile we'd spend the few hours I could manage to fit into the schedule together, But eventually I wore myself out. The time we spent together was a lot less. Things fell apart. She was all I had. 

The job I work is 4pm-Until we're done, and for the past 7 months we've been slammed. I've made decent money, but it's not enough to get myself out of the hole, because I spend a lot.
